aesthetic: Swiss Journal — academic editorial restraint with Palatino warmth, Futura precision, and red-dot constellation punctuation across a cream field
chromaticArc: Opens on parchment, first divider at slide 8 plunges to navy, cream body resumes through mid-deck with linen accent bands, second navy divider at slide 31, warm fog variation carries the final third, closing navy divider at slide 55 before a parchment coda
gridStrategy: Title zones migrate across a 5-position cycle — left-flush col 0, offset col 8, centred col 12, right-offset col 30, full-width col 0 span 58 — while body zones alternate between narrow-20 emphasis columns and wide-40 detail fields, creating asymmetric editorial spreads

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Futura used for all slide titles and labels; Palatino reserved for body text, block quotes, and code annotations — reversing the expected hierarchy for editorial tension

accentStrategy: Small 2×2 dot accents in Archive Red appear at varied grid positions on ~65% of slides — upper-right corners, baseline anchors, mid-gutter punctuation — forming a loose constellation motif, complemented by thin 1px navy rules on ~30% of slides to divide title and body zones
